meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
India mein oily aur acne-prone skin ke liye ₹500 ke andar kai behtareen options available hain jo excess oil ko control karte hain aur pores ko saaf rakhte hain.

Ye Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash **green tea aur glycolic acid** se enriched hai jo excess oil ko control karke pores ko deep clean karta hai.

Ye Dot & Key Watermelon Super Glow Vitamin C Face Wash Gel gently cleanses skin to **control excess oil** while providing a cooling effect without making it dry.

Ye Simple Kind To Skin Refreshing Facial Wash 100% soap-free aur fragrance-free formula hai jo **sensitive aur oily skin** ke liye best hai.

Ye Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash **neem aur turmeric** ke saath aata hai jo oil aur impurities ko remove karke breakouts ko roakta hai.

Ye Sebamed Gentle Facial Cleanser for Oily & Combination Skin pH 5.5 formula ke saath excess sebum ko remove karta hai aur **skin barrier** ko protect karta hai.
